title: Nor'easter delays hundreds of flights, airlines waive change fees
summary: A Nor'easter has caused significant disruptions to air travel, particularly affecting operations in Boston over the weekend. Hundreds of flights have been delayed or canceled as airlines grapple with the severe weather conditions. In response to the situation, many airlines are waiving change fees to accommodate affected passengers. Travelers are advised to check their flight statuses regularly and consider alternative arrangements. The impact of the storm is expected to persist, prompting ongoing adjustments in flight schedules.
